name: W Hoboken
positioning: A waterfront hotel directly across the Hudson from New York City, steps from the PATH and ferry, where most rooms have river-facing balconies and skyline views
best_for: Travelers who want Manhattan skyline views and quick train or ferry access to the city
Guests who want a balcony room or suite facing the Hudson

facts.text: The hotel sits on the waterfront directly across from New York City, steps from the PATH and NY Waterway Ferry.
Manhattan is one stop away by train or ferry.
Guest rooms offer views of the Hudson River, the waterfront and the NYC skyline.
The signature W bed has a pillow-top mattress, 350-thread-count sheets and a goose down comforter.
Penthouse I has two bedrooms, a powder room and a kitchenette opening into a living area.
Penthouse II has an entertainment zone with a vinyl record player.
Spa guests are greeted with a robe and reflexology sandals.
The gym has Hudson River and Manhattan skyline views.
Halifax is a waterfront restaurant with patio dining overlooking the city skyline and the Hudson River.
The Living Room Bar hosts live DJs.
Nearby parks and walkways include Pier A Park, Sinatra Park and Liberty State Park.
Pets receive a W pet bed, toys, a water bowl and treats.

highlights.text: Over 80% of rooms have river-facing balconies.
A one-bedroom suite has floor-to-ceiling windows leading to a private balcony with New York skyline views.
Woodhouse Day Spa is on site.
The hotel's design pairs skyline views with a modern maritime aesthetic.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
WhataHotel notes the contemporary design may not appeal to traditional luxury seekers.
